# HEAV3NS-JOY

> Agnostic, agent-native framework (Joyzoning) that binds every source file to one of five architectural zones, verified by a zero-dependency Node.js CLI. Not a harness, runtime, or MCP server.

## Start here
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): 60-second operational protocol, the five coding rules, and the 8-point self-check
- [README.md](README.md): overview, philosophy, quick start, agent decision rules

## Core rules (summary)
- Zones: DOMAIN (src/domain), CORE (src/core), INFRASTRUCTURE (src/infrastructure), PLUMBING (src/plumbing or src/utils), UI (src/ui)
- Every file has a [LAYER: <ZONE>] header in its first 10,000 characters, matching its folder
- Domain: no I/O, no imports from infrastructure/ui. Plumbing: stateless, imports no other zone. UI: never imports infrastructure
- Relative imports: at most 3 "../". No runtime import cycles. Core depends on I<Name> interfaces in src/domain/interfaces/

## Commands
- Audit: `node bin/joy-check.mjs <dir>` (exit 0 pass, 1 blocking violations, 2 usage error)
- Scoped, token-cheap: `node bin/joy-check.mjs . --phase pre-edit --scope <file> --neighborhood 1 --format compact`
- Explain a code: `node bin/joy-check.mjs --explain SPI-206`
- Fix headers: `node bin/joy-check.mjs <dir> --heal --dry-run`
- This repo: `npm run verify`
